uncultured.finding: Independent 2016-2017 screenshots preserve Facebook interface, names, timestamps, reply order and likes; one contains a screenshot nested inside a reply. In this media class, acquisition/interface traces appear to function as context and evidence rather than accidental noise.
uncultured.candidate: Context-preserving screenshot capture may be a distinct visual habit, but it is not yet promoted to visual grammar.
uncultured.next: test screenshots from other apps and purposes before generalizing

terminus.finding: A 2015 collective creative-city workshop synthesis distinguishes direct service from deeper enabling functions: loosen rules, release space, build platforms/interfaces and coordinate actors. This parallels the prior function-versus-tool vein in a different domain, but it is normative synthesis rather than empirical before/after evidence.
terminus.candidate: The persistent function may be condition-building/coordination even when the visible delivery mechanism changes. Low-weight confirmation only.
terminus.next: seek empirical non-elder-care cases where changing the tool exposes a persistent institutional function

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first, genre-aware scoring, screenshot/media-class separation and function-versus-tool falsification
